name: marketmage
description: MarketMage: e-commerce research and monitoring inside Claude, on live marketplace data.

plugins.name: marketmage
plugins.description: E-commerce product research and competitor monitoring, run on CleanPull's actors in your own Apify account: find and validate products, with factory prices read from Made-in-China and Alibaba, Amazon's fees from the listings themselves and a fit check for your budget; profile competitor stores, prices, reviews, promotions and ads; and schedule watchlists for prices, stock, MAP, Amazon ranks, reviews and more. Start with /marketmage:start, or just say "Is a heated eye mask worth selling for me?"
